text: PRODUCT SPECIFICATION SHEET — Chocolate Mousse Powder

This product is prepared using the following ingredients: lupin protein isolate, vinegar, almond flour, thyme, rice flour, bay leaf, mustard powder, turmeric, casein, apple cider vinegar, ginger powder. Please note this product contains the following allergens: Lupin, Milk (including lactose), Mustard, Tree nuts. Storage conditions: Store frozen at -18C or below. Batch/Lot no.: L2026150-854.
